last.verdict: Investors cheered a big revenue beat, a smaller loss and a raised delivery outlook.

reasons.label: Beat on sales and loss
reasons.text: Revenue was $2.155 billion, up 38%, versus about $1.99 billion expected; loss per share was $0.48, not $0.64.

reasons.label: R2 sells fast
reasons.text: R2 was the best-selling Rivian by volume, and deliveries rose 46% to a record 19,248.

reasons.label: Outlook improved
reasons.text: Delivery guidance rose to 67,000-70,000 and the expected 2026 adjusted loss shrank by about $100 million.

story: Rivian has moved from slow, loss-heavy quarters to fast growth as R2 ramps. The July report fell 9.6% on cash burn and weak car margins. This time sales and guidance beat expectations, though cash burn remains heavy at $1.1 billion and the stock is near lows.

history.verdict: Investors sold the stock despite a delivery raise, focusing on cash burn and weak car margins.

reasons.label: Cars still lose money
reasons.text: Automotive gross profit stayed negative at $(36) million, helped by $108 million of regulatory credits.

reasons.label: R2 launch costs
reasons.text: R2 ramp added about $100 million in costs; free cash flow was $(849) million.

reasons.label: Dilution and funding needs
reasons.text: July's $1.3 billion share sale, plus more outside capital needed for the Georgia plant, weighed on the stock.
